Geometry : L = 180 mm (x), H = 8 mm (y in [-4, +4]), T = 5 mm (z in [-2.5, +2.5])
Mesh     : 20-node hexahedra C3D20, structured, 18 x 4 x 2 elements
           (>= 16 along length, >= 4 through height, >= 2 through width)
Units    : mm, N, MPa, tonne/mm^3  (steel: E=210000 MPa, nu=0.3, rho=7.85e-9)

The script only writes the deck; it does NOT run any solver.
"""

        (1, 0, 0), (2, 1, 0), (1, 2, 0), (0, 1, 0),   # 9-12  (bottom edges)
        (1, 0, 2), (2, 1, 2), (1, 2, 2), (0, 1, 2),   # 13-16 (top edges)
        (0, 0, 1), (2, 0, 1), (2, 2, 1), (0, 2, 1),   # 17-20 (vertical edges)
